method: Explicit UV swatch whitelist inspected against the original green/red KayKit atlas; no RGB classifier and no Blender execution claimed.
protected: all non-stone atlas cells: wood, roofs, team, windows and gold
selection: All three triangle UVs must lie strictly inside the stone rectangle. Shared vertices with protected triangles are excluded to a fixed point. No topology changes.
projection: quietStonePosition/Normal are asset-root physical meters and transformed normals for 4m triplanar shader projection. quietStoneUv is diagnostic dominant-plane UV divided by 4; shared-axis conflicts are recorded, not used for rendering.
